Usage
A Kerbal on EVA can get parts from a cargo container via the part menu. The kerbal has to be up close to the container part to be able to transfer the part to its own inventory.\r\n
Once in the Kerbal’s inventory, you can click the place button on the inventory panel to begin placing it.  Follow the on-screen directions to rotate the part & deploy it.

Kerbals have an inventory. \r\nParachutes and EVA jetpacks are now swappable cargo parts that the Kerbals carry by default.  The kerbal’s inventory is also limited by the mass they can carry.\r\n
Spacecraft can carry a variety of cargo parts in specially designed cargo container parts. Command and Crew modules can also carry a small amount of cargo.
Cargo storage is limited by the available cargo slots and volume.  Some parts will only fit in the largest containers.
Some small cargo parts can be stacked into the same slot. The stacking limit depends on the size of the part.
